title: A claimable balance with nested and/or/not predicates and a B… address event
pattern: CREATE_CLAIMABLE_BALANCE with predicate and(not(before_relative 60), or(before_absolute 2100-01-01, unconditional)). The result returns the balance ID as a B… strkey, and the event names it as the destination.

hazards.placement: claimable balance with nested and/or/not predicates
ClaimableBalanceID returned in the result as a B… strkey
claimable-balance address B… in a CAP-0067 event topic

facts.says: The result returns the balance ID.
The first claimant's predicate is an and whose first branch is a not.
The transfer event goes to the B… address.
